name: Thierry Dubois
bio:
Thierry's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent glued to the television watching Formula 1 races. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Université catholique de Louvain, he began his career as a data analyst for a small GT team. This experience provided him with a solid foundation in understanding race telemetry and vehicle dynamics. 

His strategic approach is methodical and data-driven, always seeking to identify opportunities for improvement. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to make quick decisions based on real-time information. Thierry joined Manthey EMA after demonstrating his strategic acumen, keen eye for detail, and uncanny ability to predict competitor strategies during his time with a rival Porsche outfit.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Thierry is of average height with a slender build, often seen wearing glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with racing statistics.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Belgian chocolate at every race.
